changelog:
⚡ What's New & Fixed in v1.7.7:

• 📱 Background & Lockscreen Action Execution: Voice actions (e.g. open apps, control flashlight, search YouTube) now reliably execute even when JARVIS is in the background or the app is closed.

• 🎯 Strict Wake Word Filtering: Fixed false triggering on standalone 'hey' — wake detection is now strictly restricted to 'Jarvis' and direct wake phrases.

• 🚀 Enhanced Background Activity Launch: Upgraded Android 14/15 PendingIntent and accessibility launch handlers for seamless app opening from background.

• 👩 Aoede Default Voice: Aoede female voice is now the default voice for all users.

• ⚡ 0ms Hot-Standby & Continuous Hardware Mic: Zero audio clipping with instant response.
